paper_title: New ALPS Results on Hidden-Sector Lightweights
notes: ALPS LSW experiment at DESY with HERA dipole (5 T, 8.8 m), 532 nm laser. Paper reports probability limits P(gamma->WISP->gamma) ~ few x 10^-25 (Table 1). Coupling limits are given only in figures (Fig 4 pseudoscalar g-/scalar g+, Fig 5 hidden photon chi, Fig 6 MCP charge). Data points here are approximate values read from Fig 4 for the pseudoscalar ALP-photon coupling (vacuum + gas runs); flat region ~6e-8 GeV^-1 for m < ~1e-3 eV, rising for higher masses. Paper also constrains DarkPhoton (chi vs m, best lab bound, e.g. m~0.18 meV chi~1.4e-6) and minicharged particles. Not a DM haloscope, so no local density assumed.
